# Inbound alerts (`source_type: alert`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

No probe. Status follows alerts that inbound alert sources (Alertmanager, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, generic JSON) route to the metric: a firing alert makes it unhealthy or degraded.

- Runs on: Observer Cloud, no agent (do not set `agent`)
- Thresholds: not used
- testProbe: not supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: worst firing alert as a score: 0 none, 1 degraded, 2 unhealthy

## source_config fields

None. `source_config` is `{}`.

## Rules

- Inbound sources and their routing rules are set up in the console, not through the API.
- No agent and no thresholds.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: alert
source_config: {}
```
